vendors.missingNudge: Humes is later wave (Tue/Fri). Email the invoice to the AP inbox — or snap the ticket as OCR backup. Do not print the mailbox.

vendors.label: Pepsi
vendors.missingNudge: Pepsi is every other week — snap the ticket for photo OCR. First week is papers-in, not a savings or CO2 lecture.

vendors.label: Northern Lights
vendors.missingNudge: Northern Lights: same invoice number is the same ticket — dedup on inv#. Multi-sender copies are ignore. Vendor+total mismatch is a red flag, not a new bill.

notes: same pattern Sysco/US Foods at scale
vendors.missingNudge: PFG trucks are usually Tue and Fri. BOH / Seat 2 orders the day before. Match the purchase email to the invoice — mismatch is short, credit, or OOS. EFT often sits on a 21-day clock; do not treat the statement pile as this week’s due. Reminder only, not a pay screen.
